statements: given $order_id: string, $item_id: string, $account_id: string; match $item isa! item; $account isa! account; $item has item-id $item_item_id; $item_item_id isa! item-id; $account has account-id $account_account_id; $account_account_id isa! account-id; $item has stock $item_stock; $item_stock isa! stock; $item has price $item_price; $item_price isa! price; $account has balance $account_balance; $account_balance isa! balance; $item_item_id == $item_id; $account_account_id == $account_id; $item_stock > 0; $account_balance >= $item_price; let $next_stock = ($item_stock - 1); let $next_balance = ($account_balance - $item_price); update $item has stock == $next_stock; $account has balance == $next_balance; insert $purchase isa purchase, links (buyer: $account, item: $item), has order-id == $order_id;
